name: DateField
summary: A date typed in parts: day, month and year, each a segment you type in or step with the arrow keys, in the order and with the separators Intl gives the locale. Values are ISO Gregorian dates in and out; the segments can be drawn in the Gregorian or the Umm al-Qura calendar, and digits stay Western in every language. On web a bordered box like Input; on ios the same segments in the platform field height; on android a Material outlined or filled text field holding the segments. Proposed.
useWhen: A date a person knows and types faster than they pick: a birth date, an ID expiry date
A date inside a dense form where a calendar would take too much room
The time field's companion: DateField and TimeField side by side
avoidWhen: Picking a date where the days around it matter, such as a booking
A phone form where a tap is easier than typing

value.description: The date, controlled: an ISO Gregorian date such as 2026-11-17, or null for none.

onChange.description: Called with the ISO Gregorian date once every segment is filled, and with null when one is cleared.

minValue.description: The earliest date, ISO. An earlier date marks the field invalid.

maxValue.description: The latest date, ISO. A later date marks the field invalid.

isDateUnavailable.description: Gets the ISO date and the drawn date; true marks the date invalid.

placeholderValue.description: The date the segments step from while empty, ISO. Default today.

calendar.description: The calendar the segments are drawn in. A display choice only: the value stays ISO Gregorian. Umm al-Qura adds the era segment (AH, هـ), read only.

locale.description: The locale of the segment order and the separators, such as ar-SA. Default the language of the nearest Theme. dateLocale adds -u-ca and -u-nu-latn, so digits stay Western.

size.description: The box height: size.control.sm, md or lg (44, with a fixed 16px text so phones do not zoom).

invalid.description: Marks the field invalid (data-invalid, aria-invalid on the group). Inside a Field the field decides when it is not passed. A value outside min and max is invalid too.

disabled.description: No segment takes focus or changes. Stamps data-disabled.

readOnly.description: Segments take focus and are read; typing changes nothing. Stamps data-readonly.

required.description: aria-required on the group; the Field shows its mark.

autoFocus.description: Focuses the first segment on mount.

aria-label.description: The name of the field when no Field label names it.

name.description: The name of the hidden form input; it carries the ISO date.

a11y.role: group (the input part) named by aria-label or the Field label, holding one spinbutton per segment. Each segment is named by its part and the field name (day, Birth date; يوم، تاريخ الميلاد) and reads its value by aria-valuetext. Separators are aria-hidden. The era of Umm al-Qura is a read only spinbutton.
a11y.focus: One Tab stop per editable segment, in reading order. A press on the box outside a segment focuses the first empty segment, else the last. The box takes the focus ring while any segment has focus; the focused segment takes the tint fill.

keys.Tab: Moves to the next segment, and out after the last
keys.ArrowUp: Steps the focused segment up; wraps within its range
keys.ArrowDown: Steps the focused segment down; wraps within its range
keys.ArrowRight: The next segment; the one before in right to left
keys.ArrowLeft: The segment before; the next one in right to left
keys.PageUp: Steps the focused segment up by a larger amount (React Aria: 2 months, 7 days, 5 years)
keys.PageDown: Steps the focused segment down by a larger amount
keys.Home: The least value of the segment
keys.End: The greatest value of the segment
keys.Backspace: Clears the last digit, then the segment, then moves to the segment before
keys.Digits: Type the value; focus moves on when the segment is full. Arabic Indic digits are read as Western digits.
keys.Pointer: A tap on a segment focuses it; a tap on the box focuses the first empty segment. No drag.

a11y.announce: Birth date, group. Day, Birth date, spin button, 17. Month, 11, November. Empty segments read Empty (فارغ). React Aria's hidden description reads the whole date after a change.
notes: The box is control md tall (32) on web, never under 24 (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8); each segment is as tall as the box. ios and android raise the box to 44 and 56 through their platform rules (requested).
Placeholders (mm, dd, yyyy; يوم، شهر، سنة) use color.text.placeholder at 4.5:1; separators color.text.muted (1.4.3).
The focused segment is the tint text on the tint fill, 4.5:1, inside the box ring (2.4.7, 1.4.11).

Digits stay Western in every segment, placeholder, name and announcement in ar-SA, in both calendars, proved by a unit test. The segment order and the separators come from Intl: day, month, year with a slash in ar-SA.

React Aria joins a segment name and the field name with a Latin comma; in Arabic the system writes the Arabic comma instead. React Aria reads a month as a number, a dash and the month name; the system writes a comma there.
Invalid shows the danger border (3:1) and aria-invalid; the Field error says what to do (3.3.1, 3.3.3).
Under forced colors the focused segment is Highlight with HighlightText and the focus outline shows.

en.aria-label: Names the date: Birth date, Expiry date. Sentence case.
en.segments: Segment names and placeholders come from React Aria and Intl.

ar.aria-label: اسم بصيغة اسمية بدون تشكيل: تاريخ الميلاد، تاريخ الانتهاء.
ar.segments: أسماء الأجزاء وعلامات الحقل الفارغ من React Aria وIntl، والأرقام لاتينية.

react.behavior: React Aria DateField, DateInput and DateSegment (react-aria-components) through their render props; ISO values and locales from packages/shared/src/date.ts
react.note: Motion: the focused segment fill and the border color fade on duration.base (fade). Reduced motion: instant, the duration goes to 0s.

angular.note: New wave 2: the same DOM on the shared date and wheel helpers; Angular has no React Aria, so the segment keys are built on the CDK with the keyboard map of this manifest.

native.note: Phase R5 uses a system view: the compact date picker of iOS and the Material date input field on Android, through @expo/ui.

styles.web: A bordered box like Input with the segments in tabular digits; the focused segment takes the tint fill.
styles.ios: The same segments in a 44 point field, as the plain field of a grouped row (requested from the platform file).
styles.android: A Material outlined text field, 56dp tall, holding the segments (requested from the platform file).
styles.studio: The same on the Studio tokens; no recipe.
styles.desk: The same on the Desk tokens; no recipe.
styles.neutral: The same on the Neutral tokens; no recipe.
styles.liquid: The same on the Liquid tokens; no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: Storing the Hijri date the person typed
mistakes.right: Store the ISO Gregorian value; calendar only changes how the segments are drawn

mistakes.wrong: A text input with a date mask
mistakes.right: DateField: each part is a spinbutton with its own name and range
dateLocale from @the-system/shared adds the calendar and -u-nu-latn
